title: Microsoft Confirms Development of Copilot AI Super App, Integrating Chat, Coding, and Intelligent Agent Capabilities
excerpt: Microsoft is developing an AI "super app" that integrates Copilot chat, coding assistant, and intelligent agent capabilities. Satya Nadella, Microsoft's CEO, co
content_html:
Microsoft is developing an AI "super app" that integrates Copilot chat, coding assistant, and intelligent agent capabilities. Satya Nadella, Microsoft's CEO, confirmed in the latest earnings call that the app is planned to launch this year and will cover both consumer and business use cases.

Nadella stated that Copilot is rapidly evolving from a simple chat assistant to areas such as collaborative work and automation. Microsoft will integrate different Copilot experiences this quarter, including code capabilities, and incorporate them into a unified super app platform. He believes this will be an important step in Copilot's development and more details will be announced in the future.

This confirmation responds to previous reports by Fortune magazine about Microsoft's development of an AI super app. According to the report, the app will integrate multiple Microsoft AI product capabilities, including Copilot chatbot for general interactions, GitHub Copilot for developers, Copilot Cowork for team collaboration, and an intelligent agent system with task automation capabilities.

Microsoft's move also reflects the shift in AI assistant competition from single-function tools to comprehensive AI platforms. Previously, OpenAI also launched a new ChatGPT Work app, combining ChatGPT with the AI coding tool Codex, exploring an integrated AI experience in office scenarios.

In terms of finance, Microsoft's revenue in the last quarter reached $90 billion, with artificial intelligence and cloud services being key drivers of growth. As major tech companies continue to integrate models, tools, and agent capabilities, AI super apps may become an important gateway for both enterprise and individual users to access artificial intelligence in the future.

content_html_zh:
微软正在开发一款人工智能“超级应用”，集成了副驾驶聊天、编码助手和智能代理功能。 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 在最新的财报电话会议中证实，该应用程序计划于今年推出，并将涵盖消费者和企业用例。

纳德拉表示，Copilot 正在从简单的聊天助手迅速发展到协作工作和自动化等领域。 微软将在本季度整合不同的 Copilot 体验，包括代码功能，并将它们整合到统一的超级应用平台中。 他相信这将是Copilot发展的重要一步，更多细节将在未来公布。

这一确认是对《财富》杂志之前有关微软开发人工智能超级应用程序的报道的回应。 报道称，该应用程序将集成多个微软AI产品功能，包括用于一般交互的Copilot聊天机器人、用于开发人员的GitHub Copilot、用于团队协作的Copilot Cowork以及具有任务自动化功能的智能代理系统。

微软此举也反映出AI助手竞争从单一功能工具向综合性AI平台的转变。 此前，OpenAI还推出了全新的ChatGPT Work应用程序，将ChatGPT与AI编码工具Codex相结合，探索办公场景下的一体化AI体验。

财务方面，微软上季度营收达到900亿美元，人工智能和云服务是增长的关键驱动力。 随着各大科技公司不断整合模型、工具和代理能力，AI超级应用未来可能成为企业和个人用户接入人工智能的重要门户。
